description: Search state legislators and officials by name, jurisdiction, chamber, or district, or fetch specific people by OCD person ID. Party is reported on every result but cannot be filtered on — narrow by party after the call. Either jurisdiction or id is required — a search spanning all 56 jurisdictions exceeds the upstream timeout, including a name-only one, so scope every call to a single state or to specific person IDs. Use openstates_list_jurisdictions to pick a jurisdiction, or openstates_get_legislators_by_location when you have coordinates but no state. id takes the person IDs that openstates_get_bill sponsorships and openstates_get_committee memberships hand back, and resolves any number of them in one call. Supports name substring matching (case-insensitive). org_classification targets a role type: "upper" for Senate, "lower" for House/Assembly, "executive" for governors and executive officials, and "legislature" for every legislator — both chambers merged into one paginated set (all upper members, then all lower), or the single body in Nebraska and the DC Council, which excludes executive-branch officials. Omitting org_classification is not the same as "legislature": it returns every officeholder, executive officials included. include=offices adds phone, fax, and address. include=links adds website and social links.

district.description: District label (e.g., "1", "37", "At-Large"). Formats vary by state.

id.description: OCD person IDs (e.g., "ocd-person/9eddb3cd-868e-42ba-831a-b415fd7ed445"). Required unless jurisdiction is provided — it returns exactly these people, so it scopes the call on its own and needs no jurisdiction alongside it. Resolves the IDs that openstates_search_people results, openstates_get_bill sponsorships[].person.id, and openstates_get_committee memberships[].person_id hand back — any number of them in one call, subject to per_page. An ID Open States does not know matches nothing rather than failing, as does an ID paired with a jurisdiction that person does not belong to.

include.description: Related data to inline. "offices" includes phone, fax, and address. "links" includes website and social links. "other_names" includes alternate/former names, "other_identifiers" cross-system IDs, and "sources" the provenance URLs behind the record.

jurisdiction.description: State name, abbreviation, or OCD-ID. Required unless id is provided — an all-states search exceeds the upstream timeout, so every call must be scoped to a single jurisdiction or to specific person IDs.

name.description: Name or partial name to match (case-insensitive substring). Narrows within the jurisdiction; it does not substitute for one.

org_classification.description: Filter by role type. "upper" = Senate, "lower" = House/Assembly, "executive" = governors and executive officials, "legislature" = every legislator (both chambers merged into one paginated set, all upper members then all lower; the single body in Nebraska and the DC Council; excluding executive officials). Unicameral bodies have no "upper" or "lower" members. Omitting this filter returns every officeholder including executive ones — it is not equivalent to "legislature".

name: openstates_search_people

appliedFilters.description: Filters applied to this query as the server received them, for agent self-verification of zero or unexpected results.

id.description: Person IDs filtered on, as received. Absent when none were supplied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_timeout`: Open States did not answer within the per-request timeout — the query is too broad. `invalid_page`: Open States rejected the request as not found — page is past the last page for this query. `rate_limited`: The shared Open States API key reached a request cap — Open States' per-minute or daily limit, or this server's own daily budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty. Absent when results are returned.

district.description: District label or null when undistricted.

division_id.description: OCD division the district maps to (e.g., "ocd-division/country:us/state:wa/sldu:37"). Null when undistricted, absent when upstream omits it.

current_role.description: Current role or null when no active role is recorded.

email.description: Email address. Empty string when not available.

family_name.description: Family (last) name. Empty string when Open States recorded none.

given_name.description: Given (first) name. Empty string when Open States recorded none.

image.description: Official headshot URL. Absent when no photo is published.

links.description: Website and social links when include=links is requested.

note.description: Link description (e.g., "website", "twitter"). Empty string when Open States recorded no description — common on person links.

offices.description: Contact offices when include=offices is requested.

openstates_url.description: Open States profile URL. Empty string when Open States recorded none.

other_identifiers.description: Cross-system identifiers when include=other_identifiers is requested.

other_names.description: Alternate/former names when include=other_names is requested.

note.description: Note describing the alternate name. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

party.description: Primary party label. Empty string when unknown.

sources.description: Provenance sources when include=sources is requested.

note.description: Source note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

totalCount.description: Total legislators matching the query across all pages.

title: Search People
